source.scope: Exact BPRD ROM identity and authenticated pointer/frame banks; all distinct exported source states versus original static compositor with independently replayed wrapping callback schedule. No ROM or artwork is published.

flat.scope: Native TileRenderer.drawTile GPU output, every stream image and every claimed tile slot; exact decoded RGBA comparison. QA clock changes are restored. No engine file changes and no mobile performance claim.

voxel.scope: All source animation GPU atlases at native ticks 0/17/33/79/127/639 versus decoded native frame data. Foreground meshes checked against exact source cell identities, immutable textures and clock sequences. Native world screenshots are a separate visual check; no Android execution.

flat.scope: Real native world frames at identical source coordinates, fixed native animation clock; QA teleports/party and off-weather. No mobile performance claim.

voxel.scope: Real native world frames at identical source coordinates, fixed native animation clock; QA teleports/party and off-weather. No mobile performance claim.

kanto.scope: Actual RC14/RC9 ZIPs; identical baseline gbc options, fixed native/render clocks, RNG and actors, 450 presented frames per reference; isolated matched-history Viridian/Cinnabar fixtures; entire RGBA images, no mask/crop/tolerance.
